messages:
zara: canary embed-route p95 jumped to ~760ms over the last 8m, deploybot fired a warning.
deploybot: [signal] embed-canary p95=760ms (threshold=600ms); autorevert=false; advise: consider manual rollback or reduce canary traffic.
rick: saw this too. Error-rate up from 0.1% -> 1.2%. Correlates with yesterday's shard-split PR.
anika: logs include multiple `kvcache: miss shard=4` and a couple `quantize: fallback` lines. Could be dual issue.
ops-oncall-bot: runbook check: manual rollback if p95>threshold for >10m OR error-rate >0.5%. Link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback
jen: we have 9m sustained above threshold. Recommend staged rollback of canary to v3.4.3 and pin dedicated pools.
rick: agree. Plan: pause canary -> staged revert -> pin -> monitor 15m. Jen or I can execute.
jen: pausing canary now.
[deploybot] action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-embed --by=jen`
jen: paused. starting revert:
```
rollout revert --target=canary-embed --to-version=v3.4.3 --staged=4 --operator=jen
```
[deploybot] update: stage 1/4 succeeded. p95 dropped to 390ms on host-a.
anika: pinning dedicated embed pools to v3.4.3 to prevent autoscaler from scheduling the bad image. done.
[deploybot] update: revert completed for canary-embed. metadata: release_state=reverted, pinned=v3.4.3
ops-oncall-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2024-0773. Postmortem owner assigned: anika. Actions: revert shard-split PR from canary, add kv-warmup during rollout, and tighten canary gating on kv-hit.
rick: customer comm draft queued in #cust-comms: "We observed a perf regression in embeddings canary and reverted to a prior build while we investigate." Keep it short.
zara: monitoring window open for 15m. So far p95 stabilized ~420ms and kv-hit climbed back to 91%. I'll close if no regressions. :thumbsup:
note: Manual, staged rollback for embeddings canary; dedicated pools pinned; incident opened and postmortem actions assigned.
